feature_1_lesion_size.value: 1.8 cm (greatest dimension on mammogram and ultrasound; at least 1.8 cm on core biopsy pathology estimate)
feature_1_lesion_size.evidence: Mammogram: 'irregular, high-density mass measuring approximately 1.8 cm in greatest dimension'; Ultrasound: 'mass measures 1.8 cm × 1.3 cm × 1.2 cm'; Pathology: 'Invasive component size (core biopsy estimate): At least 1.8 cm'

feature_2_lesion_location.value: Left breast, upper outer quadrant, 10 o'clock position, mid depth, 4.5 cm from the left nipple
feature_2_lesion_location.evidence: Mammogram: 'upper outer quadrant at the 10 o'clock position, approximately 4.5 cm from the left nipple, at mid depth'; Ultrasound: 'at the 10 o'clock position, approximately 4.5 cm from the left nipple, at mid depth'

feature_3_calcifications_asymmetry.value: Calcifications present; fine pleomorphic morphology; segmental distribution spanning approximately 2.5 cm; within and immediately adjacent to the mass
feature_3_calcifications_asymmetry.evidence: Mammogram: 'Associated fine pleomorphic calcifications are identified within and immediately adjacent to the mass, distributed in a segmental pattern over a region spanning approximately 2.5 cm'; Pathology: 'Scattered fine calcifications are identified within and adjacent to tumor nests'

feature_4_additional_enhancement_mri.evidence: No MRI was performed or documented in this report.

feature_5_extent.value: Localized; associated DCIS present at biopsy margins
feature_5_extent.evidence: Pathology: 'Associated high-grade ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS) with cribriform and solid architecture is present at the biopsy margins.' No multifocal, multicentric, or bilateral disease stated.

feature_6_accurate_clip_placement.evidence: Biopsy Procedure Note: 'A titanium biopsy clip (omega-shaped) was deployed at the biopsy site following specimen retrieval, confirmed by post-procedural mammographic image to be in satisfactory position within the 10 o'clock left breast mass.'

feature_8_lymph_node.value: Left axillary lymph node measuring 1.4 cm with eccentric cortical thickening of 5 mm and compressed fatty hilum, suspicious for metastatic involvement; no suspicious right axillary adenopathy
feature_8_lymph_node.evidence: Mammogram: 'A prominent left axillary lymph node measuring 1.4 cm with cortical thickening of 5 mm is noted. No suspicious right axillary adenopathy.' feature_10_biopsy_method.evidence: Biopsy Procedure Note: 'Ultrasound-guided 14-gauge core needle biopsy (CNB) of the left breast mass was performed using real-time ultrasound guidance. Five core specimens were obtained.'

feature_12_histologic_diagnosis.evidence: Pathology: 'Invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC), Nottingham grade 2, measuring at least 1.8 cm; Associated ductal carcinoma in situ (DCIS), cribriform and solid type, high nuclear grade, with associated calcifications'
